mapper.update: UPDATE voucher_reversal_check SET version=#{version},status=#{status},state_json=#{stateJson},updated_at=#{updatedAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM voucher_reversal_check WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM voucher_reversal_check WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND requested_by=#{actor} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM voucher_reversal_check WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND status IN ('CHECKED','RECORDED') ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,r.process_instance_id AS process_instance_id FROM voucher_reversal_check q LEFT JOIN voucher_operation origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.operation_id LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=origin.tenant_id AND a.id=origin.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round r ON r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.application_id=a.id AND r.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE q.status='QUEUED' OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
